proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y mx my Vx Vy C r hs hVx0 hVy0 hmx hmy hVx hVy hC hr
  have hn : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hB : ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2 = Vx * s.card := ((eq_div_iff hn).mp hVx).symm
  have hD : ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2 = Vy * s.card := ((eq_div_iff hn).mp hVy).symm
  have hA : ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my) = C * s.card := ((eq_div_iff hn).mp hC).symm
  have hne : Vx * Vy ≠ 0 := (mul_pos hVx0 hVy0).ne'
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = C ^ 2 / (Vx * Vy) := by
    rw [hr, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hVx0.le, Real.sq_sqrt hVy0.le]
  have hiff : |r| = 1 ↔ C ^ 2 = Vx * Vy := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : r ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs, h]
        norm_num
      rw [hr2, div_eq_one_iff_eq hne] at h1
      exact h1
    · intro h
      have h1 : r ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [hr2, h]
        exact div_self hne
      have h2 : |r| ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        exact h1
      exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg r) two_ne_zero).mp h2
  rw [hiff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨C / Vx, ?_⟩
    have hc : ∀ i ∈ s, (y i - my - C / Vx * (x i - mx)) ^ 2 = (y i - my) ^ 2 - 2 * (C / Vx) * ((x i - mx) * (y i - my)) + (C / Vx) ^ 2 * (x i - mx) ^ 2 := fun i _ => by ring
    have hval : Vy - 2 * (C / Vx) * C + (C / Vx) ^ 2 * Vx = 0 := by
      have hx : Vx ≠ 0 := hVx0.ne'
      have e : Vy - 2 * (C / Vx) * C + (C / Vx) ^ 2 * Vx = (Vy * Vx - C ^ 2) / Vx := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e, h]
      ring
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my - C / Vx * (x i - mx)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hD, hA, hB]
      linear_combination (s.card : ℝ) * hval
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)).mp hsum
    intro i hi
    have h0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp (hz i hi)
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hA' : C * s.card = k * (Vx * s.card) := by
      rw [← hA, ← hB, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hk i hi]
      ring
    have hD' : Vy * s.card = k ^ 2 * (Vx * s.card) := by
      rw [← hD, ← hB, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hk i hi]
      ring
    have hCk : C = k * Vx := mul_right_cancel₀ hn (by rw [hA']; ring)
    have hVk : Vy = k ^ 2 * Vx := mul_right_cancel₀ hn (by rw [hD']; ring)
    rw [hCk, hVk]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y : ι → ℝ) (mx my Vx Vy C r : ℝ), s.Nonempty → 0 < Vx → 0 < Vy → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → Vx = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = (∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2) / s.card → C = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) / s.card → r = C / (Real.sqrt Vx * Real.sqrt Vy) → (|r| = 1 ↔ ∃ k : ℝ, ∀ i ∈ s, y i - my = k * (x i - mx))
